definitions.explanation: The act of planning something; a planned project or event.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{企画|きかく}を{立|た}てる。
{企画|きかく}{部|ぶ}で{働|はたら}いています。
examples.english: I work in the planning department.

examples.japanese: この{企画|きかく}は{面白|おもしろ}そうだ。

notes: Very common in business contexts. {企画|きかく}{部|ぶ} (planning department), {企画|きかく}{書|しょ} (project proposal). Can refer to both the planning process and the planned project itself.
